Yes, there is a **"FlyRank Graduate"** badge in the footer. It is located in the bottom-right section of the page, featuring a small red icon (resembling a YouTube play button or similar logo) followed by the text "FlyRank Graduate" in light blue. Below the badge, smaller text reads "AI Fluency Program."

**Is it clickable?** Based on standard web design patterns for such certification badges and the context provided, **yes, it is almost certainly a clickable link** that directs to `aifluency.flyrank.ai` (or a related FlyRank program page).

### Description of the Footer:
The footer is divided into three main columns against the dark navy background:

*   **Left Column:** Displays the name **"Mahmoud ABD ELKream"** in bold white text, followed by a short professional description: *"Front-End Developer & Product Designer. Building intuitive digital experiences for healthcare, e-commerce, and beyond."*
*   **Center Column:** Titled **"Contact me"**, it lists:
    *   Email: mahmoudabdelkreambusiness@gmail.com
    *   GitHub (link)
    *   LinkedIn (link)
*   **Right Column:** Contains the **FlyRank Graduate** badge/button for the AI Fluency Program.

**Bottom Bar:**
A thin horizontal line separates the main footer content from the copyright bar at the very bottom, which reads:
*"© 2026 Mahmoud ABD ELKream · Built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS · Alexandria, Egypt."*

There is also a dark circular button with the letter **"N"** in the bottom-left corner (likely a theme toggle or back-to-top button).
